title: Fes vs Marrakech – Which City Should You Visit?
description: Can't decide between Fes and Marrakech? We compare culture, food, atmosphere, and practical tips to help you choose.
content:
## Atmosphere

Marrakech is vibrant, chaotic, cosmopolitan. Fes is spiritual, traditional, and deeply historic.

## Medinas

Both have UNESCO-listed medinas, but Fes's is the world's largest car-free urban area – easier to get lost, harder to forget.

## Food

Marrakech offers international fusion; Fes is the birthplace of Moroccan cuisine. Don't miss the pastilla.

## Day Trips

From Marrakech: Atlas Mountains, Agafay desert. From Fes: Volubilis Roman ruins, Meknes.

## Verdict

If you have time, visit both. If you must choose, pick the experience you seek: energy and luxury (Marrakech) or authenticity and history (Fes).
